content: Human-and-model-in-the-loop training is not a new idea. Mechanical Turker Descent proposes a gamified environment for the collaborative training of grounded language learning agents over multiple rounds BIBREF19. The “Build it Break it Fix it” strategy in the security domain BIBREF44 has been adapted to NLP BIBREF20 as well as dialogue BIBREF45. The QApedia framework BIBREF46 continuously refines and updates its content repository using humans in the loop, while human feedback loops have been used to improve image captioning systems BIBREF47. wallace2018trick leverage trivia experts to create a model-driven adversarial question writing procedure and generate a small set of challenge questions that QA-models fail on.
